assertions.assertion: States Spaces isolate persisted data but not process-level dependencies
assertions.rationale: Hedges that it cannot verify Spaces and speaks generically about configuration and issuer; no clear persisted-data vs process-level statement.

assertions.assertion: Lists signing credentials, ASP.NET Core Data Protection, external caches, telemetry, rate limits and custom services as things to review
assertions.rationale: Lists signing keys, Data Protection, cache, telemetry, rate limits but omits custom services.

assertions.assertion: Notes shared signing credentials reduce cryptographic separation between spaces
assertions.rationale: Says shared signing keys mean tokens depend only on iss/aud and one key compromise affects all tenants.

assertions.assertion: Notes user databases are not space-aware unless they use the shared IStorageFactory, while Duende User Management data is routed per space by default
assertions.rationale: No mention of IStorageFactory or Duende User Management being routed per space.

assertions.assertion: Suggests a deliberately separate architecture if users must be shared across spaces
assertions.rationale: Suggests partitioning or separate instances for external customers but not a separate architecture for shared users.
